experiment: Synchronous dissemination of one immutable fact
contact_unit: one directed caller-peer contact; push-pull is full-duplex

model.topology: complete graph; peers uniformly sampled without replacement per caller
model.scheduling: all nodes contact fanout peers every round, including uninformed nodes
model.pairing: identical seed/contact schedules for push and push-pull until either terminates

ideal_star_pubsub.assumptions: fact initially at hub; simultaneous deliveries; no hub throughput limit
ideal_star_pubsub.limitation: delivery count is not a comparison of LLM inference or context cost
